_about: One Piece Card Game config for the store-discovery scripts. Every *Re value is a JavaScript regex source, compiled case-insensitive. Values are the ones OP Compare's 2026-10-03 probe/verify scripts used, lifted into data. Copy this file per game; only this file should change.
_handleRe: A collection handle (or title) that names the game. Used to pick handles from sitemap_collections_*.xml and /collections.json.
_conventionalHandles: Tried even when the sitemap does not list them (some stores hide collections from the sitemap).
_singlesHandleRe: Handles that look like singles are probed first, before the per-store handle cap bites.
_skipHandleRe: Handles never used as registry collections: foreign editions, graded, sealed, accessories, buylists, bulk. Anchored with (^|-) so 'jp' does not kill 'jpeg' and 'fr' does not kill 'free'. Known false positive: Gate Keepers (AU) keeps its singles in 'one-piece-sealed' (hand override on 2026-10-03).
_cardNumberRe: A printed card number. Searched in the product title AND in variant SKUs; the scripts count the two separately because OP Compare's importer number path reads titles only.
_foreignRe: Foreign-edition markers, tested on the TITLE. One Piece ships Japanese, Chinese, Korean and French editions; kana and kanji count too, and so does '(Non-English)' (TCGplayer-style titles: El Duelista, '[OP13-JP-110]'). englishRe ignores 'non-english' via a lookbehind.
_foreignOptionRe: Foreign markers tested on option values, variant titles, tags, product_type and body text (looser places, so only whole words).
_languageOptionRe: Option names that carry the language as a variant (starzcollectibles.de: 181 of 182 products had 'Sprache').
_gradedRe: Grading-company-plus-grade, tested on title AND variant titles (pokemillon.com hid CGC/PSA grades in variants).
_notSingleRe: Sealed product or accessories that happen to carry a set number (e.g. 'OP-09 Booster Box').
otherGamesRe: digimon|pok[eé]mon|yu-?gi-?oh|lorcana|magic: the gathering|\bmtg\b|dragon ?ball|union arena|gundam|weiss|riftbound|star wars|flesh and blood
_thresholds: minNumbered: clean (English, ungraded, single, this game) unique products with a card number needed to keep a store; OP Compare and RiftCompare both used 20. maxForeignShare: a collection is dropped when this share of its numbered products is foreign.
_markets: Market -> the ISO country sent as Shopify Markets ?country= (what the sister site's importer sends), the currency the sister site shows, and which meta.json countries belong to the market. The store's meta.json country decides its market (RiftCompare DECISIONS 2026-09-23), not its domain or the input file.
